requirements_summary: Build a secure, on-prem vector search with reranking for investigative workflows. Must ingest large archival corpora (email, PDFs, logs), support incremental ingestion, offer deterministic latency SLOs, and provide audited key management. Prefer open model variants; allow model pinning and local quantized runtimes.
technical_details: Indexing: target 150M documents (est), compressed vectordb footprint ~6-12TB depending on dim and quantization
Retrieval stack: hybrid BM25 + HNSW/faiss; aggressive prefix caching for hot sets; nightly offline rebuilds for archive indices
Reranking: GPU-accelerated cross-encoder reranker for top-k (k=50->top10); target 50-120ms rerank latency on A100-class equivalent; CPU fallback via quantized bi-encoder scoring
Throughput/latency: peak 300-600 qps ingest+query; 95p end-to-end < 250ms for investigator quick-search; background batch jobs allowed for large exports
Cost sensitivity: target <$0.02/query at steady state. Interested in Redwood Optimize for batching and cache suggestions
Security: HSM-backed keys, isolated control plane on-prem or air-gapped private control plane, SSO via SAML, full audit logs, retention controls per contract
Integration: bulk connectors (SFTP, on-prem SharePoint export), connector for existing EDR/archival stores, SIEM hooks for audit streaming
